summary: Iteration 3 testing of Biblioteca Escolar RGB (JWT auth + Books CRUD + public/admin links split + legacy field handling). Wrote new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_biblioteca_rgb.py with 20 tests across root, auth, links, books — ALL 20 passed (100%). Frontend Playwright e2e covered: discrete shield → admin login → 'Modo administrador activo' banner + admin-books-manager-btn FAB → public materia view shows ONLY badges/links (0 inputs, 0 saves, 8 'No disponible' badges for grado=g1) vs admin view shows 8 inputs + 8 save buttons + conditional remove (trash) on linked rows → Save link via materia-save-{id} succeeds and produces materia-go-{id} → BooksManager opens with seeded books and books-create-btn/book-form-* fields work → ESC closes both Library and BooksManager modals → header-logout-btn restores discrete shield and removes admin banner.

issues: Console warning carryover from iteration 2: empty string passed to when book.cover is the default ''. Non-blocking. Suggest conditional render of or fallback URL.

action_items: Optional: render conditionally in BookCard / BooksManager to avoid empty src warning.
Optional: DELETE /api/links/{g}/{m} returns 200 {deleted:0} for non-existent resources; consider 404 for symmetry with /api/books DELETE (which already returns 404).
Optional: Iteration 2 noted the FAB at bottom-right may overlap Emergent preview badge in tests — used force=True to bypass; not a user-facing issue.
Optional: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event lifecycle; migrate to lifespan context manager.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/links GET correctly handles legacy field names ({grado, materia} OR {grado_id, materia_id}) — verified by direct Mongo insert + GET assertion in test_legacy_field_handling.
server.py login() sets cookie with secure=true samesite=none (works on HTTPS preview); Bearer token in body provides robust fallback used by frontend.
BookUpdate correctly filters None so PUT /api/books/{id} performs partial updates without clobbering untouched fields (verified in test_put_book_partial_update).
DELETE /api/books/{id} idempotency: second delete correctly returns 404 (verified). DELETE /api/links/.. is non-idempotent (returns 200 with deleted:0).
Seed_admin in startup is idempotent and updates password hash if env ADMIN_PASSWORD changed — good. Bcrypt $2b$ hash format verified.
JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD all loaded from /app/backend/.env (no hardcoded secrets).
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exclusively; localStorage 'rgb_admin_token' with Authorization Bearer header — good pattern.
POST /api/links accepts URLs starting with '/' (relative); spec says http/https only. Harmless.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented — acceptable for MVP, flag if playbook requires it.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes; admin/public split is enforced both server-side (require_admin) and client-side (isAdmin in MateriaItem).
